exit 0
--- stdout
Read and update runtime configuration using the same dotted keys as liza get.
Supported keys: config.post_worktree_cmd, config.auto_resume, config.max_instances,
config.doer_max_wait, config.reviewer_max_wait, config.await_poll_interval,
config.runtime_input_registry and config.agent_env_deny.
The general state query remains available: liza get config.post_worktree_cmd --json
Usage:
liza config [command]
Available Commands:
get Read a supported config key
set Set a supported config key
Flags:
-h, --help help for config
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza config [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
